subject: english
question:
**Direction: Select the most appropriate synonym of the underlined word.**

He was the **__discreet__** boy in our group but more hardworking than all of us.
solution:
The correct answer is **"reserved."**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **"Discreet" **means careful and circumspect in one's speech or actions. (सावधान, सतर्क (कि दूसरे को परेशानी न हो))

 
 
• **Example**: *I don’t want anyone to find out about our agreement, so please be **discreet**__.*
 
 
 
• **"Reserved"** means not revealing one's thoughts or feelings readily. (संकोची तथा मनोभावों को छिपाकर रखने वाला)
 __
 
• **Example**: *Marcus is more **reserved**__ than his brother.*
 
 
 
• In this context, the word **"Reserved"** is the synonym of **"Discreet."**
 
• The correct answer is option 3.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **Option 1, "loud"**, means making a lot of noise; not quiet. (बहुत आवाज़ करता हुआ; कोलाहलपूर्ण)
 
• **Option 2, "outspoken"**, means saying exactly what you think or feel although you may shock or upset other people. (मुँह-फट, स्‍पष्‍टवक्ता, खरा बोलने वाला)
 
• **Option 4, "noisy"**, means making a lot of noise and being loud. (शोर मचाने वाला; शोर-भरा, कोलाहलपूर्ण)

39:Tc3e,
